page.notes: Scan is clear throughout; no doubtful readings. Long s and u/v normalised as instructed (e.g. fauorem to favorem, vrgeret to urgeret, Vngaris to Ungaris). Bavariae is printed "Bauariae" and was normalised to "Bavariae" only for the v/u rule, so spelling is otherwise as printed. Edge marks at the left and right margins and the blurred shadow at the bottom are the neighbouring page or scan edge and were left out.
